title: Gumtree Australia Scraper input
description: Give the scraper either ready-made gumtree.com.au search URLs, or a keyword with optional location and category. Every listing card on the result pages becomes one dataset row.

searchUrls.title: Gumtree search URLs
searchUrls.description: Any gumtree.com.au search, category or location result page, copied from the address bar. Examples: `https://www.gumtree.com.au/s-rtx+4070/k0` (keyword), `https://www.gumtree.com.au/s-sydney/exercise+bike/k0l3003435` (keyword in a region), `https://www.gumtree.com.au/s-components/c18552` (category), `https://www.gumtree.com.au/s-components/c18552?ad=wanted` (only Wanted ads). Filters and sort order in the URL are respected. Takes priority over the keyword fields below when both are given.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search phrase, e.g. `exercise bike`. Used only when no search URLs are given.

location.title: Location
location.description: Gumtree location ID: the number after `l` at the end of any gumtree.com.au result URL (`.../k0l3003435` is Sydney Region). `sydney` is accepted as a shortcut. Leave empty to search all of Australia.

category.title: Category
category.description: Gumtree category ID: the number after `c` in a category URL (`/s-components/c18552` is Components). Leave empty to search all categories.

adType.title: Ad type
adType.description: Offering = people selling, Wanted = people looking to buy (Gumtree's own filter, `?ad=wanted`). Rows always carry an `isWanted` flag regardless of this setting.

sortBy.title: Sort order
sortBy.description: Gumtree's own sort options (`?sort=`). Use `Most recent` for change tracking, `Cheapest` for price research.

maxItems.title: Maximum listings
maxItems.description: Stop after this many unique listings in total (across all start URLs). Gumtree shows 24 listings per page, so 100 items is about 5 page loads.

includeDescription.title: Fetch full description
includeDescription.description: Open every listing page to add the full `description`, `condition`, `postcode` and `sellerType`. Costs one extra page load per listing, so it is roughly 25x slower than result pages alone. Off by default; the result-page `snippet` (first ~500 characters) is always included.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: gumtree.com.au sits behind bot mitigation (Peakhour) that refuses datacenter and headless-browser traffic. Apify residential proxies with country set to Australia are the tested configuration. Running with no proxy works from a residential Australian connection only.

maxRetries.title: Retries per page
maxRetries.description: How many times a blocked or failed page is retried with a fresh proxy session before it is given up.

requestDelaySecs.title: Delay between page loads (seconds)
requestDelaySecs.description: Politeness pause before each page load, randomised between 50% and 150% of this value. Raise it if you see 429 responses.

pageTimeoutSecs.title: Page timeout (seconds)
pageTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum time to wait for a result page to load and render its listing data.
